ValidationRule.description: Restricting the SSA Role not to create quote based on the Quote Classification
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Setup.PMC_ProcessSwitches__c.PMC_BypassValidationRule__c), $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> 'API Only profile', NOT(ISCHANGED( PMC_CPQ_FlowVRByPassToggle__c )), $UserRole.Name ="SA Sales Service Analyst (SSA)", AND( OR(Text(PMC_CPQ_QuoteClassification__c) = "Bid", Text(PMC_CPQ_QuoteClassification__c) = "Deal"), Text(SBQQ__Type__c) = "Quote") , ISNEW())
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Sales Support Analyst can create only List and Amendment Quotes
